Eosinophilic pustular folliculitis of infancy, also known as eosinophilic pustular folliculitis in infancy, infantile eosinophilic pustular folliculitis, and neonatal eosinophilic pustular folliculitis, is a cutaneous condition characterized by recurrent pruritic crops of follicular vesiculopustular lesions.[1]
